name: lemonade-sdk/lemonade
summary: 据维护者介绍，Lemonade 可在本地运行模型，提供面向大语言模型、语音、文本转语音和图像生成的推理引擎，各引擎的硬件要求不同。

Lemonade’s maintainers describe a server for running models locally. Its inference engines cover language models, speech, text-to-speech, and image generation, with hardware requirements that vary by engine.
